0022600089.text: Both the Memphis Grizzlies and the Utah Jazz open their 2026-27 seasons at home for Memphis, and Isaiah Stewart is out for the Grizzlies with an ankle injury. Utah will be without Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, and Kyle Filipowski is day-to-day with a back issue and listed as a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Utah won the most recent meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026.
